authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly prints Phalura hate-tāṛ, -tōṛo and -thōṛō palm of hand. The survey hatetoṛo is therefore analysed in full as inflected hand + tāḍa palm/clap, in that order; its genitive vowel is ordinary morphology, not a separate lexical node.
